author: ssicevs
name: range-navigator
description: Focus + context price history: a detail chart sits over a compressed mini-map of the whole series. Drag the brush window to pan, pull an edge to zoom, and hover the plot for a dashed crosshair whose card reads that point's price and date. Axis ticks and end labels are derived from the current window. Light and dark via shadcn theme tokens; respects reduced motion.
